scope: Independent expectations for Planner #287 advisory software only. All materials, limits, timings, costs and access decisions in the test cases are fictional. Source links supply documented capability roles only.

public_capability_sources.role: in-situ observation and distinct extracted sampling
declared continuous feed, in-line observation and collection

expected.measurement_consumes: the exact distinct aliquot identity, without assuming a destructive measurement
expected.measurement_output: a data identity dependent on the aliquot, with no inferred scientific result

cases.fictional_inputs: A declared observation begins inside a held interval, uses a compatible separate observer and the same declared batch identity, and produces data rather than an aliquot.
cases.expected: No extra extracted material or reduction in retained amount. Distinct observer occupancy. If simultaneity, supported physical observation, or data-source identity is missing, mark it unresolved.

cases.fictional_inputs: Required volume capacity 12 and sample positions 4. Configuration A has volume capacity 16 and 2 positions. Configuration B has volume capacity 10 and 8 positions.
cases.expected: Neither configuration is eligible. No union of limits, and missing value in either stays unknown.

cases.fictional_inputs: Two ready 3-minute operations require the same exclusive provider. A third unrelated 2-minute operation uses a different available resource.
cases.expected: Provider operations cannot overlap, exclusive provider occupancy 6, earliest elapsed 6 with the unrelated operation allowed to overlap.

cases.fictional_inputs: A necessary handoff duration or provider availability is unknown.
cases.expected: Known subtotal, unresolved complete schedule or configuration assessment, and no preference benefit from missing inputs.

cases.fictional_inputs: Known fictional fixed charge 10, missing necessary provider charge.
cases.expected: Known subtotal 10, complete cost unknown. Missing component is visible, never treated as zero for comparison.

cases.fictional_inputs: Same nominal record with separate missing-routing, missing-rate and wrong-dimension cases.
cases.expected: Explicit incomplete or unsupported finding. No calculated actual throughput, scheduling credit or ranked advantage.

cases.fictional_inputs: Requested branch depends on an unobserved data result, or an unmodelled recirculation path.
cases.expected: Explicit unknown/unsupported behavior without a guessed branch, output or completion time.

cases.fictional_inputs: Run unchanged legacy and reviewed-assessment/1 regression fixtures with the broader profile unselected.
cases.expected: Existing defaults, released report shape, historical readback and hardware refusal remain unchanged.
